tiers.title: Foundations
tiers.summary: The instrument before the music. Nothing here is about acting — it is about knowing what your voice does, repeating it on purpose, and not hurting yourself along the way.

units.title: Meet Your Voice
units.summary: A baseline take, a map of your range, and an honest inventory of the habits you cannot hear yet.

units.title: Breath & Support
units.summary: Diaphragmatic setup, sustained tone under load, and the silent catch-breath that keeps a long line from collapsing.

units.title: Articulation & Diction
units.summary: Consonants are where intelligibility lives. This unit trains precision without tipping into the over-enunciated read that marks an amateur.

lessons.title: Plosive Precision
lessons.brief: Read at a steady, conversational pace. Land every P, B, T, D, K and G cleanly — but keep the mic off-axis so the plosives stay crisp without thumping. Keep the tempo even, and don't push the P: let the consonant do the work while the breath behind it stays quiet. We score consonant clarity and plosive control together, because they pull against each other.
lessons.script: Peter picked a bitter batch of pickled peppers, packed them tight, and put the barrel back beside the broken gate. The proper paper was buried beneath a big black book, but Bobby brought it back before breakfast.

lessons.title: Taming the S
lessons.brief: Sibilance is the fastest way to sound harsh on a condenser. Read this with fully formed S sounds that stay short — stop each one early and let the vowel carry the line. Long, hissing S sounds cost points; swallowed ones cost more.
lessons.script: She sells sea shells, and the shells she sells are surely seaside shells. Six slick sisters swiftly stitched a silk sash, then set it aside to see whether the stitches would settle.

lessons.title: The Middle of the Word
lessons.brief: Most people articulate the start and end of a word and let the middle go. This passage is built almost entirely from words that fall apart if you do that.
lessons.script: Particularly probable statistics regularly deteriorate under comparable circumstances. The temperature fluctuated considerably, and the laboratory's preliminary interpretation was consequently unreliable. February, library, comfortable, deteriorate.

lessons.title: The Tempo Ladder
lessons.brief: Same line, three times: slow, conversational, then fast. Clarity must hold at every rung. Your score is the *lowest* clarity across the three passes, so the fast one is where the unit is won or lost.
lessons.script: The rugged brigadier bragged briefly about the burglary before breakfast, then hurried back through the bracken.

lessons.title: The Over-Articulation Dial
lessons.brief: Now the opposite problem. Read this twice — once deliberately over-enunciated, once genuinely conversational. We score the *difference*: you should be able to hear the dial move. Precision you cannot switch off is a limitation, not a skill.
lessons.script: I told him I would be there at eight, and I meant it. It is not complicated. He just has to answer the phone.

lessons.title: Hear It Done Well
lessons.brief: Listen for the consonants, not the performance. Notice how little effort the plosives take, and how the sound stops rather than trailing. Then answer the two prompts below.
lessons.script: Listen twice. The first time, follow the meaning. The second time, ignore it entirely and listen only to the ends of words.

units.title: Pitch & Resonance
units.summary: Chest, mask and head placement; mapping your usable range; holding and bending a contour on command.

units.title: Microphone Technique
units.summary: Proximity effect, off-axis positioning, plosive control, distance dynamics, and setting gain by ear rather than by meter.

units.title: Warm-Ups & Vocal Health
units.summary: Build a routine you will actually do, learn to read strain signals early, and practise the cool-down nobody bothers with.

units.title: Reading Aloud
units.summary: Sight-reading fluency, phrasing, marking a page, and treating punctuation as a musical score rather than grammar.

units.title: Foundations Check
units.summary: An unseen battery drawn from all seven units. Passing opens Tier 2.
